clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau wrote that talcum powder, the kind in Johnson's baby powder, was linked to cancer and hormone problems.

The government called it a lie. They said he was making false claims and scaring people for nothing.

He went to prison anyway, for exercising his First Amendment right to say what he believed was true.

Twenty years later, the science caught up. Talcum powder has since been tied to hormonal imbalances and proven to cause cancer, just like he said.

He served time for a truth the world wasn't ready to hear yet.

Would you risk prison to say what you believe?

#kevintrudeau #naturalcures #freespeech #truthteller #talcumpowder #mindset

Kevin Trudeau's own lawyer warned him: you're probably going back to prison.

Kevin says he looked inward instead of panicking, and told his lawyer something good was about to happen.

Minutes later the judge walked in and said something nobody expected: I am biased against Mr. Trudeau, and I am recusing myself from this case. Then he left.

The FTC was stunned. His own lawyer was stunned. Kevin says he wasn't, because he'd already felt it coming.

He calls it miracle number one. Everything shifted from that moment.

Do you trust your gut before the outcome even shows up?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #mindset #yourwishisyourcommand #law #belief
